endorsements.name: Public Or Livery Passenger Conveyance Exclusion
endorsements.notes: Standard exclusion. Acceptable for machine shop.

endorsements.name: Silica Or Silica-Related Dust Exclusion
endorsements.notes: Excludes silica-related claims arising from auto operations.

endorsements.name: Exclusion — Hydraulic Fracturing
endorsements.notes: Frac exclusion. Not relevant to machine shop operations.

endorsements.name: Individual Named Insured
endorsements.notes: This endorsement is designed for policies where the Named Insured is an INDIVIDUAL — it extends coverage to spouse/family members for personal autos. Precision Aero is an INC. Presence of this endorsement on a corporate policy is anomalous and likely either an administrative error or there is an individual on the policy not disclosed in the Dec. Verify with carrier.

endorsements.name: Common Policy Conditions
endorsements.notes: Standard 10-day nonpayment / 30-day other-reason cancellation notice. NOT extended to 60 days by any visible carrier endorsement.

endorsements.name: Conditional Exclusion of Terrorism
endorsements.notes: ANOMALY — this is a Commercial Umbrella terrorism exclusion form (CU prefix), not Auto. It also references policy number 005935979 (NOT this policy's number 005917541). This page appears to belong to a different policy (likely the Umbrella) and was inadvertently bound into this Auto PDF. Verify document integrity.

exclusions_of_note.name: Symbol 7 limitation on Physical Damage, Medical Payments, UM, UIM
exclusions_of_note.impact: Only the two specifically described autos (2018 Ram, 2020 Express) are covered for Comp/Collision, Med Pay, UM, and UIM. Hired Auto Physical Damage not purchased separately (Item Four). Any rented or borrowed vehicle has zero physical damage coverage; any employee occupant of a non-owned vehicle has zero Med Pay or UM/UIM. Liability uses Symbol 1 (Any Auto) which is correct.

exclusions_of_note.name: Hired Auto Physical Damage — NOT PURCHASED
exclusions_of_note.impact: Item Four shows Hired Auto Liability ($47 premium / $1,000 estimated cost of hire) but BOTH Comprehensive and Collision rows are blank. If Precision Aero rents a truck or van, any physical damage to that rental is uninsured. Loss-of-use charges from rental agency would also fall on the insured. Rental agreements routinely make the renter responsible for physical damage to the vehicle.

exclusions_of_note.name: Hired Auto cost of hire estimated at only $1,000/year
exclusions_of_note.impact: Premium is rated on a $1,000 annual cost-of-hire estimate. If actual hired-auto exposure exceeds this, audit will assess additional premium AND a coverage dispute could arise if loss occurs on a vehicle whose hire wasn't reported. Verify against actual rental activity.

exclusions_of_note.name: Motor Transit Cargo — NO COVERAGE
exclusions_of_note.impact: No cargo coverage. If Precision Aero transports machined parts, tooling, or inventory in a covered auto and an accident damages the cargo, no coverage applies under this policy. A machine shop with valuable in-transit parts may need a Motor Truck Cargo or Inland Marine policy.

exclusions_of_note.name: Personal Injury Protection — NO COVERAGE
exclusions_of_note.impact: Acceptable — Arizona is a tort/at-fault state, not a no-fault state, so PIP is generally not required.

exclusions_of_note.name: Uninsured Motorists Property Damage — NO COVERAGE
exclusions_of_note.impact: If an uninsured at-fault driver damages a Precision Aero vehicle, the only recovery for the vehicle damage is via the policy's Collision coverage (subject to $500 deductible). UMPD is optional in AZ — many insureds buy it specifically to avoid using their collision deductible after an uninsured-driver loss. Worth pricing.

exclusions_of_note.name: Form of Business — NOT SELECTED
exclusions_of_note.impact: Dec page Form of Business field reads literally 'NOT SELECTED' even though Named Insured is 'Precision Aero Inc' (a corporation). This is an administrative defect. In the event of a claim, an insurer could (rarely, but possibly) raise misrepresentation arguments around the application. More immediately: the Auto policy contains an 'Individual Named Insured' endorsement (CA 99 17), which is designed for individual-named policies, not corporations. The combination suggests the policy was issued without correctly identifying the entity type.

exclusions_of_note.name: Individual Named Insured endorsement (CA 99 17) attached to a corporate policy
exclusions_of_note.impact: CA 99 17 extends coverage to spouse/relatives for personal autos when the Named Insured is a natural person. Precision Aero is 'Inc' — there is no individual to extend coverage from. Either (a) this endorsement is misattached and should be removed, or (b) there is an individual Named Insured (e.g., owner) that is not disclosed on the Dec. Verify with carrier.

exclusions_of_note.name: Asbestos Exclusion (CA 31 37)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Carrier exclusion. Not material to typical machine shop auto exposures.

exclusions_of_note.name: Lead Liability Exclusion (CA 31 36)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Carrier exclusion. Not material to typical machine shop auto exposures.

exclusions_of_note.name: Silica or Silica-Related Dust Exclusion (CA 23 94)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Auto-policy silica exclusion. For a machine shop with grinding/cutting operations, silica exposure is a real general liability concern but unlikely to arise from the operation of a covered auto. Acceptable on Auto.

exclusions_of_note.name: Abuse or Molestation Exclusion (CA 31 40)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Carrier exclusion. Not typically claim-relevant for a machine shop.
